source.denominator: offline cpfcandlt_* of the category, excluding lost tracks and pile-up-like tracks (|dxy| < 0.1 mm and |dz| > 1.0 mm); matching done on all candidates
source.assumption: offline tracking efficiency uniform in d0 within each (|eta|, pT) bin

dz_acceptance.note: charged hadrons, not lost, prompt (|dxy| < 0.1 mm); offline |dz| w.r.t. the offline PV; binned (|eta|, pT, |dz|) - measures HLT tracking's z acceptance, which Delphes formulas cannot express (their dz is absolute)
